summary: Join our Ethical Considerations in Real Estate Practice Training Course to learn essential principles that promote ethical standards in the real estate industry
lede: Ethical real estate practice means making fair, transparent decisions and handling competing interests responsibly. For agents, property managers, valuers and other real estate professionals, this course offers practical guidance on recognizing conflicts of interest, communicating honestly, and assessing ethical risks in transactions, marketing and valuations.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for real estate professionals who routinely navigate ethical choices in their work.
audience: Real estate developers and project managers
Legal, compliance, or risk officers in real
modules: Foundations of Ethics in Real Estate Practice
Conflicts of Interest and Fiduciary Duties
Fairness, Non-Discrimination, and Access to Housing
Truthful Marketing, Valuation, and Information Integrity
Handling Client Funds, Documents, and Confidentiality
Ethical Decision Making in Complex Transactions
Technology, Social Media, and Digital Real Estate Ethics
Responding to Misconduct, Complaints, and Whistleblowing
Building an Ethical Culture in Real Estate Organizations
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate operations and at least two years of experience in the real estate industry. No prior knowledge of ethical theory is required, but a willingness to engage in reflective practice is essential.
